title: Security and Efficiency of eCTR Instantiations
summary: The two proposed eCTR permutation instantiations are expected to provide beyond-birthday-bound security, but formal proofs and efficiency analyses remain open.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved problem is to prove the formal security of the proposed eCTR-based tweakable enciphering scheme when its permutation $P$ is instantiated either with the 5-round Feistel candidate based on a block cipher or with CTET+ at $w=2$. These candidate constructions are described as expected to provide beyond-birthday-bound security, but formal security proofs and efficiency analyses are explicitly left open. The task is therefore to establish a formal security proof for each instantiation and to analyze the efficiency of both the 5-round Feistel and CTET+ with $w=2$ constructions.

scope.domain: Block-cipher-based tweakable enciphering schemes using eCTR with either a 5-round Feistel or CTET+ permutation.
parameters: P: permutation used by the eCTR-based tweakable enciphering scheme
5 rounds: fixed round count of the Feistel candidate
w: CTET+ construction parameter fixed at 2
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove formal security for both permutation instantiations and analyze the efficiency of the 5-round Feistel and CTET+ with w=2 constructions.
